description: Given an Airbnb listing URL and trip dates, finds the same home bookable somewhere else (on HomeShared, where guests pay no service fee, or on a host's own booking site) and returns each match with its all-in total including fees and taxes, how confident the match is, a link, and when the price was checked, plus the savings against the Airbnb total for the same nights when that total is known (airbnb_total, or Airbnb's own prices for homes that copy them). Reads only that one public Airbnb listing page; it doesn't search Airbnb. If the home isn't listed anywhere else it returns no offers and says so.

airbnb_total.description: Optional: the total in USD that Airbnb shows at checkout for these dates and guests. Savings are measured against it when given. Without it, savings are reported only for homes whose prices are copied from their Airbnb calendar, against Airbnb's prices for the same nights

airbnb_url.description: The Airbnb listing link, e.g. https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/12345678

check_out.description: Check-out date (the morning the traveler leaves), YYYY-MM-DD

infants.description: Guests under 2; they don't count toward capacity. Default 0

name: find_cheaper
title: Find a cheaper stay
